ideas.title: Dig for Zombies
ideas.hook: Dig up a haunted graveyard, unearth zombies of every rarity and put them to work in your crypt.
core_loop: Dig graves with your shovel to unearth zombies
Zombies earn coins while they shamble around your crypt
Upgrade shovels to reach deeper, rarer graves
Rebirth for a permanent dig multiplier
ideas.twist: When the moon is full, other players can sneak into your crypt and steal your best zombies.
ideas.why_now: Break/mine/dig is the fastest-rising mechanic (3.0× momentum, 13 young games, 185K CCU) and steal + break pairs already hold 125K young CCU. No tracked game pairs digging with zombies, and it lands in October.
ideas.differentiator: Swaps eggs for a Halloween graveyard and makes the collected items characters that move around your base, not static eggs.

ideas.title: Roll for Eggs
ideas.hook: Roll giant dice around a board game world; every tile you land on cracks open a surprise egg.
core_loop: Roll dice to move around a looping board
Land on egg tiles to hatch pets of random rarity
Pets add extra faces and multipliers to your dice
Rebirth to unlock a bigger board
ideas.twist: Land on another player's tile and you can steal their egg before it hatches.
ideas.why_now: Dice/cards is at 2.7× momentum, led by Anime Dice at 69K CCU (53 days old). Eggs ride the biggest young-game pairing (hatch + steal: 17 games, 242K CCU). No tracked game pairs dice with eggs.
ideas.differentiator: Turns the dice into movement on a board game, so every roll is a decision, not just a reveal.

ideas.title: Mine for Swords
ideas.hook: Mine glowing ores, forge them into swords, and use every sword to mine deeper.
core_loop: Mine ores and gems (+1 strength every swing)
Forge ores into swords with random stats
Better swords break harder rock layers
Rebirth to keep your best blade's power
ideas.twist: A boss guards each rock layer; beat it with your forged sword to open the next one.
ideas.why_now: Stones/ores is the fastest-rising theme (2.6×, led by +1 Stone Skipping at 47K CCU), Forge/craft is at 1.9× (+1 Loot To Forge, 46K) and the +1 formula is at 2.7×.
ideas.differentiator: Links mining and forging into one loop where the weapon you make is also your mining tool.

ideas.title: +1 Heat Volcano Escape
ideas.hook: Every step gives +1 heat resistance. Run up an erupting volcano for crystals before the lava wave hits.
core_loop: Gain +1 heat resistance every step
Sprint up the volcano and grab elemental crystals
Escape the lava wave back to base
Spend crystals on speed and rebirth
ideas.twist: Ice crystals freeze the lava for a few seconds, opening shortcuts for the whole server.
ideas.why_now: Elemental themes are at 1.9× (Firefighting Sim hit 25K CCU in 15 days), the +1 formula is at 2.7× with 16 young games, and escape-from-a-hazard loops are proven.
ideas.differentiator: Combines the +1 stat grind with a short, tense escape run, so every rebirth feels like a new attempt.

ideas.title: Guess the Price to Get Rich
ideas.hook: A game show where guessing the price of wild items pays for your mansion.
core_loop: Guess the price of an item faster than the server
Closest guesses win cash
Spend cash furnishing your mansion
Climb from a shack to a sky castle
ideas.twist: Bid your winnings on mystery boxes; some hold a fortune, some hold a rubber duck.
ideas.why_now: Money is the broadest rising theme (2.1×, 25 young games, 170K CCU) and quiz/guess games are rising (Guess the Song at 4K). Quiz × money is one of the top untapped pairs.
ideas.differentiator: Turns a quick-round quiz into a long-term tycoon, so players keep something between rounds.

ideas.title: Steal a Ghost
ideas.hook: Vacuum up ghosts in a haunted mansion, and steal other players' ghosts when the lights go out.
core_loop: Catch ghosts with your vacuum
Ghosts in your crypt earn ectoplasm
Upgrade your vacuum to catch faster, rarer ghosts
Rebirth for a permanent catch multiplier
ideas.twist: Every few minutes the lights cut out and crypt doors unlock for raids.
ideas.why_now: Hatch + steal is the strongest young pairing (17 games, 242K CCU), and horror steal games are already working (Steal An EXE Egg, 12K at 29 days). Ghost-catching is a fresh verb for the format right before Halloween.
ideas.differentiator: Replaces passive eggs with an active catch (vacuum aiming) and a blackout timer that makes raids an event.

ideas.title: +1 Strength Anime Launch
ideas.hook: Train +1 strength every punch, then launch giant anime villains across the map.
core_loop: Punch training dummies for +1 strength
Launch a villain as far as you can
Distance pays gems for hero summons
Rebirth to unlock farther, wilder zones
ideas.twist: Summoned heroes add their own launch combos with big anime effects.
ideas.why_now: Hit/swing/launch is at 1.9× (+1 Stone Skipping 47K, Swing For Eggs 18K) and anime is at 1.6× (Anime Dice 69K). Hit × anime is an untapped pair.
ideas.differentiator: Launches characters instead of balls or eggs, and the heroes you summon change how launches play.

ideas.title: Sluggers VS Pitchers
ideas.hook: Fast 1v1 baseball duels where every bat and pitch has a superpower.
core_loop: Pick a side: slugger or pitcher
Win quick duels to earn bat and ball crates
Collect bats and pitches with special powers
Climb a ranked ladder
ideas.twist: Hit the ball out of the park and it lands in another duel's arena.
ideas.why_now: The "___ vs ___" formula is at 2.0× (Ball VS Ball at 41K CCU, 56 days old) and sports is at 1.5× with 8 young games.
ideas.differentiator: A 1v1 batter-versus-pitcher duel instead of a ball brawl, with collectible powers on both sides.

ideas.title: Draw Anime to Get Rich
ideas.hook: Draw anime characters with stamp-and-trace tools, sell them to fans and grow a manga studio.
core_loop: Trace or stamp an anime character
Fans walk in and buy your art
Upgrade your studio and hire assistants
Expand into a manga empire
ideas.twist: Open brush capsules for legendary brushes that add glowing effects to your art.
ideas.why_now: Paint/create is at 1.6× (Paint to Get Rich: 24K CCU at 48 days) and anime is at 1.6×. Paint × anime is an untapped pair.
ideas.differentiator: Anime-specific drawing tools and gacha brushes give a fandom audience its own art tycoon.

ideas.title: Build a Mech Brawler
ideas.hook: Scrap parts from a junkyard, forge your own mech and brawl in the arena.
core_loop: Break junk piles for mech parts
Forge parts into arms, legs and cores
Brawl other mechs in battlegrounds
Upgrade parts with arena winnings
ideas.twist: Defeated mechs drop a part you can steal and bolt onto your own.
ideas.why_now: Battlegrounds are still rising (1.2×, Huss Valley at 80K CCU in 37 days), break/mine is at 3.0× and forge/craft at 1.9×. "Build a ___" titles are at 1.4×.
ideas.differentiator: A battlegrounds game where your fighter is something you build from loot, so progression is visible on the battlefield.
